entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Th-This is [fName]-senpai's room...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I'm so nervous... What should I do?
Try to relax.
Same here.[clr 27]
Deep breaths.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Y-You say that, but even the scent of[n]your room is making my heart—

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Well, I feel happy, but...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: R-Really? You always seem so calm,[n]I'd never have guessed...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: But hearing that does make me feel a[n]little better. Maybe we're not so different.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: R-Right. Deep breaths. Phew... hah...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: U-Um. The more I smell your scent,[n]the faster my heartbeat goes...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: [fName]-senpai, you've helped me[n]discover all kinds of new experiences.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: All I ever thought about was gymnastics.[n]But I guess love really changes how[n]you think...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Just from thinking of you, I have days[n]where I can't sleep... and sometimes[n]my chest will just tighten up...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: But... it all just makes me feel happier.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I want to spend so much more time with[n]you... I want you to be mine, and mine[n]alone...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: ...But maybe that's being selfish...
That's not true.
I like when you're selfish.
I want the same thing.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: [fName]-senpai...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I'm so happy... I'm so glad I had the[n]courage to say what I said...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: You're too kind, [fName]-senpai.[n]If you say things like that...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I'll just start feeling more needy...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: *giggle* I'm so happy that you[n]feel the same.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: We're going to be together forever.[n]It's too late for you to back out.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Just being in the same room with the[n]man I love... It's making me feel[n]almost greedy.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I-I want to show you a side of me[n]that only you'll know...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Wow, my heart is pounding so hard[n]right now...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Do you feel the same way, Senpai?
Sumire and I spent some[n]time alone together...
entries.uk: Ми із Суміре провели трохи[n]часу наодинці...

entries.en: It was getting late, so I took[n]her to the train station...
